issues.message: Goal event e-000286 has recipient_id null; ORN-08 assist is fabricated.
Text says 107.3 km/h but metric_ref shot_speed is 92.1857 (aggregate).
Shot pressure is exactly 0.35, not under 0.35.

verification.notes: deterministic verifier; model reviewer flagged issues (advisory)

decision.reason: Verification status is pass and the moment is high-importance (opening goal, 0.95), but the check surfaced an error-level model issue: goal event e-000286 has a null recipient_id, so the credited ORN-08 assist in claim 2 is not supported and must be removed or corrected before airing. Two further inconsistencies (claim text states 107.3 km/h against a 92.1857 shot_speed metric_ref, and 'under 0.35 pressure' when pressure is exactly 0.35) also need fixing. Hold until the goal/assist wording and the speed and pressure figures are reconciled, then it is a strong lower-third candidate for the next stoppage.
